The course catalog is fixed and contains exactly these courses and sections (days are M T W R F, where R is Thursday; times are 24-hour HH:MM; each section meets on every listed day):
COMP 140 Computational Thinking, 4 credits, no prerequisites: COMP 140-001 MWF 09:00-09:50; COMP 140-002 TR 10:50-12:05.
COMP 182 Algorithmic Thinking, 4 credits, prerequisites COMP 140: COMP 182-001 MWF 10:00-10:50; COMP 182-002 MWF 13:00-13:50.
COMP 215 Introduction to Program Design, 4 credits, prerequisites COMP 182: COMP 215-001 TR 09:25-10:40; COMP 215-002 MWF 11:00-11:50.
COMP 301 Functional Programming, 3 credits, prerequisites COMP 215: COMP 301-001 TR 13:00-14:15.
COMP 321 Introduction to Computer Systems, 4 credits, prerequisites COMP 215 and ELEC 220: COMP 321-001 TR 14:30-15:45.
ELEC 220 Fundamentals of Computer Engineering, 4 credits, prerequisites COMP 140: ELEC 220-001 TR 09:25-10:40.
MATH 212 Multivariable Calculus, 3 credits, no prerequisites: MATH 212-001 MWF 09:00-09:50; MATH 212-002 TR 13:00-14:15.
MATH 355 Linear Algebra, 3 credits, prerequisites MATH 212: MATH 355-001 TR 10:50-12:05.
STAT 310 Probability and Statistics, 3 credits, prerequisites MATH 212: STAT 310-001 TR 10:00-11:15.
PHYS 101 Mechanics, 3 credits, no prerequisites: PHYS 101-001 MWF 11:00-11:50; PHYS 101-002 TR 13:00-14:15.
DSCI 101 Tools and Models for Data Science, 3 credits, no prerequisites: DSCI 101-001 MWF 10:50-11:40.
These are all the courses and sections in the catalog.
Build a schedule with exactly one section of each wanted course. A schedule is valid when no two chosen sections meet on a shared day at overlapping times (back-to-back, e.g. one ending at 10:50 and another starting at 10:50, is fine), every course's prerequisites are in the completed list, no wanted course is already completed, and the total credits (the sum of the chosen courses' credits) are at most max_credits, inclusive. If a valid schedule exists, answer with found true and section_ids listing one section of each wanted course (any order); if none exists, answer with found false and an empty section_ids.
